For the Appellant(s) : Mr. R. S. Mazumdar, Sr. Advocate For the State : Mrs. Priya Shrestha, Spl. PP .........
03/13.08.2024: I.A. No. 6823 of 2024 This interlocutory application has been filed on behalf of the appellant praying therein to suspend the sentence and release him on bail during the pendency of this appeal.

2. The appellant has been convicted for the offence under Sections 366 and 376(3) of IPC and Sections 6 and 8 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act in connection with Special (POCSO) Case No. 29 of 2020 arising out of Chirkunda PS Case No. 57 of 2020.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: He has been sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for 20 years with a fine of Rs.5,000/- for the offence under Section 6 of POCSO Act along with other sentences.

3. Heard, learned counsel for the appellant and learned Spl.P.P. for the State and have gone through the impugned judgment, the evidence and the Trial Court Records.
4.
It is submitted by the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the appellant that there is absolutely no evidence of age of the victim as she has not been medically examined by the Doctor.
As per the prosecution case, she was kidnapped from the house but there is no evidence that any person from the house raised alarm.
Neither victim raised any alarm nor she resisted from being taken by the accused person.
When her father came she fled away from there and was later rescued by the police.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 5. Learned Spl.PP has defended the judgment of conviction and sentence and opposed the bail petition.
It is submitted she is a minor and her consent was inconsequential.

6. Considering the fact that there is no medical evidence and she left the house at the night of the incident where the entire family members were there, we are inclined to allow this Interlocutory application.

Accordingly, upon suspending the sentence, the appellant, namely, Vikash Singh @
Dram Singh is directed to be released on bail during the pendency of this appeal, on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.10,000/- (Rs. Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Special Judge POCSO Act, Dhanbad, in connection with Special POCSO Case No. 29 of 2020 with a condition that the appellant shall appear and mark his attendance before the Registrar, Civil Court, Dhanbad, once in every four months till the disposal of this appeal.
7. I.A. No.6823 of 2024 stands allowed.
(ANANDA SEN, J.) (GAUTAM KUMAR CHOUDHARY, J.)
